questions_and_answers.question: What type of states or actions does the UNREAL or SUBJUNCTIVE express?

answers.answer: Possible, not actual states or actions

questions_and_answers.question: Which forms mark a present possibility in German?
What additional construction can indicate present possibility besides simple unreal forms?

answers.answer: An infinitive plus könnte or würde

questions_and_answers.question: How is a possibility existing in the past referred to?

answers.answer: Past possibility or contrary to fact

questions_and_answers.question: Which sentence shows a past contrary-to-fact condition?

answers.answer: Er hätte ihr einen Brief geschrieben, wenn er ihre Adresse gewusst hätte
Wenn es regnen würde, würden wir zu Hause bleiben
Er schreibt einen Brief, wenn er Zeit hat

questions_and_answers.question: What phrases are equivalent to hätte and wäre when expressing past possibility?

answers.answer: w würde ... haben and würde ... sein

questions_and_answers.question: What is always present in a past possibility verb phrase?

answers.answer: A past participle and an unreal auxiliary

questions_and_answers.question: What is often used to mark present conditional sentences?

answers.answer: Phrases with an infinitive plus könnte or würde

questions_and_answers.question: Why might a longer phrase with würde be avoided in past possibility sentences?

answers.answer: It is a matter of individual style
It is required in both clauses
It expresses future instead of past

questions_and_answers.question: In which clause may the longer würde phrase appear in a conditional sentence?

answers.answer: In either the wenn-clause or the main clause, but usually not both

articles.text:
A. THE UNREAL or SUBJUNCTIVE - PRESENT AND PAST POSSIBILITY
I. The UNREAL or SUBJUNCTIVE was discussed in Unit 18, where we noted that it expresses possible, not actual states or actions. Let us look again at some of the examples:
Ich wünschte, sie würde sich von einem Spezialisten untersuchen lassen.
Wenn Sie den Jungen jetzt gleich in die Sprechstunde bringen würden, könnte ihn Herr Doktor sofort behandeln.
Es wäre kein Problem, das neue Auto zu kaufen, wenn wir mehr Geld hätten.
I wish she'd have herself examined by a specialist.
If you'd bring the boy right to the office now the doctor could treat him immediately.
Buying the new car would be no problem if we had more money.
In these examples reference is to actions or states which are possible of fulfillment at the present time. We say that reference is to PRESENT POSSIBILITY. Note that PRESENT POSSIBILITY is marked by simple UNREAL forms (hätte or wäre) or by phrases with an infinitive plus könnte or würde. Conditional sentences expressing PRESENT POSSIBILITY are sometimes called PRESENT CONDITIONAL sentences.

II. In the present unit we have encountered additional sentences with the UNREAL or SUBJUNCTIVE. Note the following examples:
Ich wollte, ich wäre nie Kandidat geworden.
Wäre ich es nicht geworden, hätte ich schon damals grosse Schwierigkeiten gehabt, meinen Betrieb zu halten.
Ich wäre schon eher geflohen, wenn ich nicht die Hoffnung gehabt hätte, dass sich die Zustände ändern würden.
I wish I had never become a probational party member.
Had I not become one it would have been very difficult for me even back then to keep my business going.
I would have run away before that if I hadn't had hopes that conditions would change.
These sentences express a possibility which existed at some time in the past. We say that reference is to PAST POSSIBILITY. Because this is a possibility which no longer exists we sometimes refer to sentences of this kind as CONTRARY TO FACT. Note that PAST POSSIBILITY is always marked by a verb phrase containing a past participle and an UNREAL form of the auxiliary verb. Conditional sentences expressing PAST POSSIBILITY are also called PAST CONDITIONAL or PAST CONTRARY-TO-FACT CONDITIONAL sentences.

III. In Unit 18 we noted that the phrases würde ... haben and würde ... sein are equivalent to the simple UNREAL forms hätte and wäre. They also occur with past participles in expressing PAST POSSIBILITY. Note the following sentence pairs:
Er hätte ihr einen Brief geschrieben, wenn er ihre Adresse gewusst hätte. oder Er würde ihr einen Brief geschrieben haben, wenn er ihre Adresse gewusst hätte.
Wir wären früher gegangen, wenn nicht noch Neumanns gekommen wären. oder Wir wären früher gegangen, wenn nicht noch Neumanns gekommen sein würden.
He would have written her a letter if he had known her address.
We would have gone earlier if the Neumanns hadn't come too.
The use or avoidance of the longer phrase with würde in sentences expressing PAST POSSIBILITY is a matter of style, subject to considerable individual variation. In conditional sentences it may occur in either the wenn-clause or the main clause, although usually not in both, i.e., not twice in the same sentence.
